latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release enabling quick extraction and download of captions from Instagram videos.

- Upload a 60-second Instagram Reel and request captions as a 1080p video or text/SRT file.
- Automated backend workflow: quick API-based caption extraction and export, no timeline editing or manual export needed.
- Supports multiple formats (mp4, mov, avi, webm, jpg, png, gif, mp3, wav, etc.) with up to 500MB file size.
- Offers anonymous token workflow for easy onboarding and 100 free credits valid for 7 days.
- Designed for fast turnaround — typical clip processes in 20–40 seconds; all operations run on remote GPU servers.
